voice.welcome: Welcome to your calm corner. Pick what your body needs.
voice.breathe-intro: Breathe with Sunny. Tap Sunny's glowing belly when you're ready.
voice.breathe-in: Smell the flower. Breathe in slowly.
voice.breathe-out: Blow the cloud. Breathe out slowly.
voice.breathe-nudge: Tap Sunny's belly for a slow breath.
voice.breathe-complete: Three soft breaths. Your body found a slower rhythm.
voice.squeeze-intro: Press and hold the squishy ball. Let go when your hands are ready.
voice.squeeze-nudge: Press the squishy ball and let go.
voice.squeeze-complete: Your wiggles have room to settle.
voice.draw-intro: Draw a happy place. Pick a cozy color, then let your finger wander.
voice.draw-nudge: Touch a patch, then draw anywhere on the soft blanket.
voice.draw-complete: You made a place that feels like you.
voice.rest-intro: Tap the sleepy stars. Make the room as quiet as you like.
voice.rest-nudge: Tap a star, or rest with Sunny.
voice.rest-complete: You can rest here whenever you need.
